# svg-slides set: Terminal (`terminal`)

<!-- GENERATED by bin/draw-slide-sets.js. Edit the script, then re-run it. -->

Dev-console style: near-black field with a faint 6 percent green grid, code-block panels with a 3 px accent bar on the left, prompt-style ($ and >) eyebrows, a scanline band, Courier New throughout in bright phosphor green with one cyan-blue second accent. The light theme is a paper console: off-white, near-black text, green kept for accents only. Flat geometry only. Not any template's brand.

```
node bin/compose-slide.js title-hero --set terminal --payload payload.json --theme light --out slides/
```

The six slide designs keep the lab set's slot names, kinds, required flags and line counts, so any
payload that fits these budgets composes in every set. Character budgets follow this set's fonts.
Shared conventions, gates and the layout rule: [`../../README.md`](../../README.md).

**References** (composition and palette cues only, no assets copied):
- Terminal and developer-console colour schemes (phosphor green on black, Dracula-style panels): green headings, dim-green secondary text, a blue-cyan second accent.
- Code-block UI conventions: dark panel, a coloured bar on its left edge, a prompt prefix on the first line.

colour-block fill and the text on it (`--ink` / `--on-ink` likewise for a reversed field). Inlined svg-library components pick up the same palette.

## Catalog

| # | Design | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `title-hero` | Cover: a faint 6 percent grid and a thin scanline band; one large code-block panel with a 3 px accent bar on its left edge holds every text slot flush left, the eyebrow led by a $ prompt. |
| 2 | `section-break` | Section divider: the chapter number in a code-block panel on the left; eyebrow (with a > prompt), two-line title and orientation line on the grid to the right. |
| 3 | `big-statement` | Takeaway slide: a wide code-block panel with a 3 px accent bar holds the > eyebrow, three flush-left statement lines and the attribution. |
| 4 | `content-two-col` | Content slide: faint grid and scanlines; body text and the key point (blue bar) in code-block panels on the left; the graphic in a code-block panel with a caption on the right. |
| 5 | `full-diagram` | Figure slide: a large code-block panel for the graphic and a narrow blue-barred panel for the takeaway, on the grid. |
| 6 | `closing` | Closing slide: grid, scanlines and one wide code-block panel holding the title, up to three contact lines and the meta line. |
